title.zh: 接线G01全探针阶段环境依赖
title.en: Wire all-probes environment dependencies in G01 script

intent.zh: G01 all-probes 阶段首次跑到全部 ignored 探针后暴露 25 项失败，逐条分类均为 env/外部依赖类（源码漂移 0 项：T4 源码身份已由 repin-9/f1faa15 收口）。本任务把既有可离线满足的环境依赖接到 all-probes 阶段：T4 固定上游源码根、T4 历史证据根、当前捕获根、gravity 证据目录、mixed 报告、machine-code 目录、native/collision mocks 与 lifetime 日志；前置不满足的探针跳过并显式记录 env 未接线，不硬跑、不伪造 env。接线后逐 target 记录结果，仍失败的真实数值/审计缺口另立债务任务。不改断言、容差、W-D5 排除清单。
intent.en: The G01 all-probes stage reached the full ignored-probe set for the first time and exposed 25 failures, all classified as environment/external-dependency class (zero source-identity drift; T4 source identity closed by repin-9/f1faa15). This task wires the offline-satisfiable environment dependencies into the all-probes stage: frozen upstream source root, T4 historical evidence root, current capture root, gravity evidence dirs, mixed reports, machine-code dir, native/collision mocks and lifetime logs. Probes whose prerequisites are unavailable are skipped with an explicit env-not-wired record; nothing is hard-run or fabricated. Per-target results are recorded; genuine numeric/audit gaps become separate debt tasks. Assertions, tolerances and the W-D5 exclusion list stay unchanged.

acceptance: scripts/test-windows-g01.ps1 的 all-probes 阶段为可离线满足的 env 依赖接线（T4_FROZEN_UPSTREAM_ROOT、T4_EVIDENCE_ROOT、T4_CURRENT_CAPTURE_ROOT、GRAVITY_*_EVIDENCE_DIR、MIXED_*_REPORT、MACHINE_DIR、native/collision mocks 与 lifetime 日志等），复用既有 native 构建脚本且先验证离线可构建。
前置不满足的探针显式跳过并记录 env 未接线（不伪造 env、不硬跑）；排除清单仍只有 W-D5 的 3 项历史工具。
接线后逐 target 记录 all-probes 结果；仍失败项按真实数值/审计缺口分类，另立债务任务登记。
不改断言逻辑、容差与排除清单；证据写 docs/development-evidence/g01-all-probes-env/；回执含 task_id。
完成后复跑 G01 debug 全脚本并记录各阶段与 all-probes 数字；若只剩 RNE 数值缺口，如实报「除 RNE 外全绿」。
note: 依据：repin-9（f1faa15）收口源码身份后，`cargo --all-features -- --ignored --no-fail-fast` 全 target 枚举 25 项失败，逐条分类：MJWARP_FROZEN_UPSTREAM_ROOT 8 项、报告/证据目录 env 6 项、native DLL/环境 10 项、RNE 数值探针 1 项（另立 2026-10-22-g02-rne-acc-native-tolerance-debt，只做证据不修）。既有 G01 脚本 native 阶段已设置 MJWARP_NATIVE_MOCKS/MJWARP_NATIVE_LIFETIME_LOG/MJWARP_MUJOCO_DLL，all-probes 阶段未继承 T4/gravity/mixed/machine 类 env。本任务只做脚本环境接线与逐 target 记录，不改任何测试断言/容差/排除清单；真实数值缺口另立债务。枚举日志 target/allprobes-enum.log、失败明细 target/allprobes-failures-detail.txt。
